source.title: Irish News, 5 June 1964, p. 1 ("Rural council election results"); Londonderry Sentinel, 20 May 1964, p. 1 ("Six Limavady rural contests?")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: The five counts read in the Irish News of 5 June 1964; the division read on the page image of the Londonderry Sentinel, 20 May 1964, p. 1 (council-audit, Nov 2026): 'Bellarena, Mr. William Canning, Bellarena (Mr James Boylan)'.

note: Triennial election of Limavady Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. All five outgoing members were re-elected by convincing majorities in the five contested divisions. This is the Bellarena division: the Irish News result prints 'Ballyrena', a misprint, and the Londonderry Sentinel nominations of 20 May 1964 print Bellarena. Printed: 'Ballyrena: James Boylan 153, W. Canning 50.'
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of the Londonderry Sentinel, 20 May 1964, p. 1 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the division is Bellarena (the Irish News's 'Ballyrena' is a misprint); the nomination notice added to the citation. The file and index name are left for the lander to rename.
